q: A dedicated, fast network that gives storage devices network access is called a:
explain: **SAN** = شبكة مخصصة وسريعة للتخزين.

q: The primary goal of a SAN is:
choices: Data transfer between the server and storage devices
explain: **Data transfer between the server and storage device is the primary goal of SAN**.

q: Which SAN type offers high performance but is expensive?
explain: **FC SAN → High performance, expensive**. أما **iSCSI** فرخيص وأبطأ.

q: Which SAN type is described as next-generation and ultra-fast for flash storage?
explain: **NVMe over Fabrics → Next-gen, ultra-fast for flash storage**.

q: In.............., hosts and storage are connected via hubs.
explain: **FC-AL (Arbitrated Loop)**: بالـ hubs، و bandwidth محدود، و SAN islands.

q: In.................., FC switches replaced hubs.
explain: **Switched Fabric**: switches بدل hubs، فأداء و scalability أحسن.

q: In ................, we interconnect remote/geographically separated SANs.
explain: **IP-based SANs** بتربط SANs بعيدة (iSCSI و FCIP).

q: The three basic components of a SAN are:
explain: **Servers · Network infrastructure · Storage**.

q: In Fibre Channel, hosts, storage and tape libraries are all referred to as:
explain: **In fibre channel, devices ... are all referred to as nodes**.

q: In FC SAN, .......... are used for short distances (up to 30m) in back-end connections.
explain: **Copper: up to 30m, back-end**.

q: In FC SAN, ............ carry data as light signals and are used for front-end SAN connectivity.
explain: **Optical fiber cables carry data as light signals**.

q: Which fiber type uses multiple light beams at different angles and is limited to about 500 m?
explain: **MMF**: كذا شعاع، و modal dispersion، و ~500m.

q: Signal weakening in multi-mode fiber due to beam collisions is called:
explain: **Modal dispersion**.

q: Single-mode fiber (SMF) supports distances up to about:
explain: **SMF: up to 10 km**، و core ~9 µm.

q: The most common core size of single-mode fiber is:
explain: **SMF core 7–11 µm (most common = 9 µm)**. أما MMF فـ OM1 = 62.5 و OM2/OM3 = 50.

q: Which fiber connector supports up to 4 Gb/s, is smaller, and is commonly used today?
explain: **LC: up to 4 Gb/s، smaller، commonly used today**. و **SC: 1 Gb/s**، و **ST: bayonet lock**.

q: ............ are larger, more powerful versions of FC switches used in enterprise/data center SANs.
explain: **Directors**: port count أعلى و fault tolerance.

q: Why are hubs no longer used in SANs?
choices: Low-cost, high-performance switches are available and hubs share bandwidth
explain: الـ hubs **bandwidth مشترك**، والـ switches بقت رخيصة وسريعة.

q: In an FC switch, each node has a dedicated communication path, resulting in:
explain: **Each node has a dedicated path → bandwidth aggregation**.

q: SAN management software is described as the ______ of the SAN.
explain: **SAN management software is like the 'brain' of the SAN**.

q: Which SAN management capability divides the SAN logically so only authorized hosts access specific storage?
explain: **Zoning (Logical Partitioning)** بيحسّن الأمان والأداء.

q: ................ is a node port used in Arbitrated Loop (FC-AL) topology.
explain: **NL_port = Node Loop port**.

q: ................ is a switch port that connects to an N_port.
explain: **F_port (Fabric Port)** ← N_port.

q: .......... is a switch port that connects to NL_ports in an FC-AL loop.
explain: **FL_port (Fabric Loop Port)** ← NL_ports، فيعمل **public loop**.

q: .........is a port that connects two switches.
explain: **E_port (Expansion)**، والرابط اسمه **ISL**.

q: The link between two E_ports is called:
explain: **ISL = Inter-Switch Link**.

q: A port that can function as either an E_port or an F_port depending on what it connects to is a:
explain: **G_port (Generic)**: auto-detect.

q: An arbitrated loop without a switch is called a:
explain: **loop without a switch = private loop**، ولو متوصل بالـ fabric عن طريق FL_port يبقى **public loop**.

q: Fibre Channel speeds range from:
explain: **From 1 Gb/s (initial) up to 128 Gb/s (modern FC)**.

q: A single FC fabric can theoretically support up to about:
explain: **~15 million nodes**.

q: Fibre Channel is standardized and managed by:
explain: **ANSI T11 Technical Committee**.

q: ............. is an FC switch function that enables nodes within the fabric to be logically segmented into groups that can communicate with each other.
explain: **Zoning**.

q: ............ are the basic elements of zoning (hosts, storage ports, or WWNs).
explain: **Members**، والعضو ممكن يبقى في أكتر من zone.

q: How many zone sets can be active in a fabric at any time?
explain: **Only one zone set can be active at a time in a fabric**.

q: Zoning is used in conjunction with ______ for controlling server access to storage.
explain: **Zoning is used in conjunction with LUN masking**.

q: Port zoning is also called:
explain: **Port Zoning = Hard Zoning**: آمن جدًا بس محتاج reconfiguration.

q: Which zoning type allows a device to be moved to another port without updating the zoning?
explain: **WWN Zoning**: الـ WWN فريد وثابت، فمرن، بس أقل أمانًا (spoofing).

q: Which zoning type ensures a specific WWN is only valid on a specific port?
explain: **Mixed Zoning**: Port + WWN، أمان ومرونة.

q: In a core-edge fabric, hosts are usually connected to the ______ tier and storage to the ______ tier.
explain: **Servers ← edge** · **Storage ← core**.

q: In a dual-core topology, each edge switch must connect to:
explain: **Dual-Core**: كل edge يتوصل بالـ coreين بـ ISLs، فـ high availability و load balancing.

q: In ........., every switch is directly connected to every other switch in the fabric.
explain: **Full mesh**: hop واحد، ومناسب لعدد switches قليل (≤ 4).

q: In ........., several hops or ISLs may be required for the traffic to reach its destination.
explain: **Partial mesh**.

q: A disadvantage of full mesh topology is that it:
choices: Is not scalable as the number of switches grows
explain: **Full mesh: Not scalable — too many connections**.

q: iSCSI encapsulates ______ into IP packets.
explain: **iSCSI encapsulates SCSI commands in IP network packets**.

q: In iSCSI, the client device that initiates requests is the ______ and the storage device is the ______.
explain: **Initiator** (host) ← **Target** (storage).

q: A software iSCSI initiator:
choices: Runs in the OS and uses a standard Ethernet NIC
explain: **Software Initiator: runs in the OS, uses the standard Ethernet NIC**. أما الـ hardware initiator فهو iSCSI HBA.

q: Which is a disadvantage of iSCSI?
choices: Higher latency compared to Fibre Channel SANs
explain: عيوب iSCSI: latency أعلى، و congestion، وأداء بيعتمد على الـ Ethernet، ومخاطر أمنية (CHAP/IPsec).

q: FCIP encapsulates ______ into IP packets mainly to connect geographically distant SANs.
explain: **FCIP = FC frames over IP**، لربط SANs بعيدة.

q: FCoE encapsulates FC frames into Ethernet frames and requires:
choices: Lossless Ethernet using Data Center Bridging (DCB)
explain: **FCoE** محتاج **lossless Ethernet (DCB)** و **CNAs**.

q: A main advantage of FCoE is:
choices: Reduced cabling by converging LAN and SAN over Ethernet
Lower latency than native FC over WAN
explain: **FCoE: Reduces cabling and hardware by converging LAN and SAN over Ethernet**.
